plan: Trim QQQI to 20% to reduce concentration and align with conservative limits.
Sell all leveraged ETFs (METU, SOXL, SPAL, MUU, PLTU, MSFU) to zero for capital preservation.
This plan prioritizes de-risking the portfolio by removing high-beta and leveraged positions.
It aims to reduce overall portfolio volatility and margin call risk.
conservative.read: This conservative plan targets a modest ~1.5% monthly return, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces drawdown risk by eliminating leveraged positions and lowering concentration. Expect lower volatility but also limited upside potential.

plan: Trim QQQI to 25% to meet concentration limits.
Reduce all leveraged ETFs (METU, SOXL, MSFU, MUU, PLTU, SPAL) to small positions (<=3%) to manage risk.
Introduce DRIP with a 4% allocation, based on its strong scanner risk/reward setup.
This plan balances growth potential with risk management, maintaining a small leveraged exposure.
balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for ~2.5% monthly growth, prioritizing risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while adding a high-quality scanner setup. Expect moderate volatility and a balanced risk-reward profile.

plan: Trim QQQI to 25% to meet concentration limits.
Increase exposure to existing leveraged ETFs (METU, SOXL, MSFU, MUU, PLTU, SPAL) to 6% each, leaning into growth.
Buy DRIP with a 6% allocation, leveraging its strong scanner setup.
This plan aggressively uses leverage and concentrates in high-beta sectors for maximum growth potential.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% monthly growth by stretching exposure and using leveraged ETFs. This approach significantly amplifies both potential upside and drawdown risk. Leveraged ETFs decay daily, and strict stop discipline is crucial to manage potential rapid and substantial losses.

plan: Sell all high-beta and leveraged ETFs (METU, SOXL, MSFU, MUU, PLTU, SPAL) to zero.
Increase QQQI allocation to 30% to boost income generation.
This plan focuses on rotating into income-generating assets for steady distributions.
It prioritizes low drawdown and reliable income over growth.
income.read: This income plan targets ~1% monthly yield, focusing on parking cash for distributions. It significantly reduces growth-oriented and leveraged positions for stability. While aiming for steady income, distributions are variable, and NAV can still fall in market downturns.
